adversarial_disruptions.action: Open a REL file as PHY and a PHY file as REL.
Present a synthetic negative file with a 2.0-only header.
Reject finalization of provisional host text.
Submit an Insomnia span absent from its accepted source turn.
Replay a candidate with no valid source link.
adversarial_disruptions.expected_mutation: no graph edge or Freshness birth

adversarial_disruptions.action: Resolve an Entity against a stale Memory body revision.
Return an embedding with the wrong dimension.
Request principal A context with principal B private evidence.
Include a tombstoned or inactive branch in retrieval candidates.
Return unknown external delivery status.
Retry a committed import epoch with conflicting bytes.
Race cancellation against finalization and replay a stream cursor.
Resume work using a revoked or wrong-kind principal grant.
Publish maintenance output over an existing destination.
Prune an active or referenced payload.
Attempt reclaim without proof of unreachable backing.
Reconcile unsupported divergent work history.
Request a future or foreign-owner logical history cut.
Run unsupported cva or phy CLI command.
Read or reopen through a revoked principal.
Omit a mandatory matrix row from the evidence inventory.

expected_vs_observed.expected: Two distinct REL and two distinct PHY owners of declared kinds; 12 scripts, 48 accepted turns, source hashes and reopen-stable captured identities; malformed/wrong-kind input fails unchanged.
expected_vs_observed.observe_via: Public create/open plus fresh-process owner info; compare runtime IDs by manifest alias, not hardcoded UUID.

expected_vs_observed.expected: All accepted turn bodies and parentage roundtrip exactly; three forks retain named canonical and noncanonical branches; rejected provisional text is absent from Archive.
expected_vs_observed.observe_via: Authenticated append/finalize results, independent Archive read and fresh reopen; assert branch IDs and source-node links.

expected_vs_observed.expected: Exact quoted source spans yield project Memory in the designated REL and private preference Memory in the matching PHY, with source/body/owner binding and terminal receipts.
expected_vs_observed.observe_via: Gateway/Application receipts plus fresh owner-session/public read; assert no orphan records on rejected Episode, forged span, or wrong route.

expected_vs_observed.expected: One accepted first pass, exact canonical/duplicate/supersession graph state and stable history; replay creates no duplicate edge or Freshness birth.
expected_vs_observed.observe_via: Dream worker receipt and separate owner graph/history proof before and after process reopen.

expected_vs_observed.expected: Known, new and ambiguous Entity outcomes reference the exact accepted Memory body revision; stale, foreign and unresolved targets publish nothing.
expected_vs_observed.observe_via: Entity worker decisions and independent Entity/history reader keyed by source Memory and owner.

expected_vs_observed.expected: Fixed profile IDs and finite vectors bind to expected source IDs and generation cuts; reopen/retry reuses mappings, invalid dimensions/profile/cut preserve prior rows.
expected_vs_observed.observe_via: Vector worker receipts and independent vector-store read after a fresh session; run F03 ID goldens separately.

expected_vs_observed.expected: Bounded context includes only authorized REL/PHY sources and exact pinned repository bytes within budget; revocation, forged revision, foreign PHY and overflow prevent leakage/commit.
expected_vs_observed.observe_via: Context result, pinned VCS proof and independent source bytes; assert excluded IDs and unchanged authority on failure.

expected_vs_observed.expected: Passive and agentic retrieval return the authored candidate IDs/order and exact revisions while excluding foreign, retired, pruned and inactive branch evidence.
expected_vs_observed.observe_via: Gateway retrieval receipts and separately reopened source revisions; compare ordered IDs with retrieval_acceptance_cases.

expected_vs_observed.expected: Internal reads award no credit; exactly one Freshness receipt follows confirmed consumption, and exact retry/reopen does not repeat credit; unknown/rejected/mismatch/revocation awards none.
expected_vs_observed.observe_via: Host delivery receipt plus independent Freshness history cut before/after confirmation and retry.

expected_vs_observed.expected: Supported native 2.1 import normalizes topology and settles one epoch; same-input retry is deduplicated and conflicting/incomplete retry fails without mutation.
expected_vs_observed.observe_via: Import workflow receipt, independently reopened Archive topology, owner identity and epoch history.

expected_vs_observed.expected: One submitter-bound queue winner, ordered durable checkpoints and replay cursor survive restart; canceled, held, corrupt-tail and competing output never become visible.
expected_vs_observed.observe_via: Gateway queue/stream receipts plus process-reopened public transcript and absence checks.

expected_vs_observed.expected: Unique workers quiesce and resume authorized pending work exactly; unsupported host contract stays Held; revoked/foreign/wrong-kind access is denied.
expected_vs_observed.observe_via: Worker lifecycle and host operation receipts after Gateway reopen; assert no unauthorized execution or read.

expected_vs_observed.expected: Supported REL/PHY rewrite policies independently reopen with required evidence closure and identity/generation rules; destination collision and stale plan fail, original cohort bytes stay identical.
expected_vs_observed.observe_via: Fresh destination readers, before/after source hashes and typed maintenance errors.

expected_vs_observed.expected: Eligible terminal payload is removed while tombstones/history and active references remain correct; active or ambiguous carriers reject without source mutation.
expected_vs_observed.observe_via: Independent post-prune readers, retained-history proof, source digest and negative typed result.

expected_vs_observed.expected: Only proven unreachable backing is removed; all live mappings reopen, second reclaim is an exact no-op, and unproven references are retained.
expected_vs_observed.observe_via: Fresh verifier, mapping comparison, output/source digest and second-run equality check.

expected_vs_observed.expected: Supported same-owner prefix/replay preserves branch, import, Dream, Insomnia and Freshness authority; unsupported divergence publishes nothing and changes neither source.
expected_vs_observed.observe_via: Independent readers of source and reconciled copy, replay receipt and exact byte comparison on retry.

expected_vs_observed.expected: Before/after REL and PHY cuts expose complete retained revision/evidence streams and stable canonical proofs; future/foreign/tampered streams fail typed.
expected_vs_observed.observe_via: Separate fresh-session history/proof API calls at named cuts; compare typed proof fields, not debug text.

expected_vs_observed.expected: Fresh CLI process reports create/info/verify/history/dry-run/copy results consistent with public API; unsupported command, flags, kind, format and collisions return nonzero JSON errors without source change.
expected_vs_observed.observe_via: Captured process exit code and JSON stdout/stderr plus exact source digest before and after.

expected_vs_observed.expected: Standalone consumer imports only reliquary-memory and verifies bounded management/provenance, quiesce/reopen, revocation and PHY privacy; viewer write and revoked reads fail.
expected_vs_observed.observe_via: Independent consumer process output and newly opened public API handles; verify no cross-principal source appears.

expected_vs_observed.expected: Every G4-01..19 row has executable positive and negative evidence; approved 23-package/76-edge DAG, formatting, locked/offline workspace/CLI/docs/consumer gates pass.
expected_vs_observed.observe_via: Exact command/exit/test totals, current DAG edge counts and row inventory in final evidence report; any missing row blocks acceptance.
